ValidationRule.description: All room types have a valid value (empty or greater/equal than 0)
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( ISBLANK(roomTypeFullHouse__c) = FALSE, roomTypeFullHouse__c < 0 ), AND( ISBLANK(roomTypeBathroom__c) = FALSE, roomTypeBathroom__c < 0 ), AND( ISBLANK(roomTypeKitchen__c) = FALSE, roomTypeKitchen__c < 0 ), AND( ISBLANK(roomTypeLivingRoom__c) = FALSE, roomTypeLivingRoom__c < 0 ), AND( ISBLANK(roomTypeBedroom__c) = FALSE, roomTypeBedroom__c < 0 ), AND( ISBLANK(roomTypeFireplace__c) = FALSE, roomTypeFireplace__c < 0 ), AND( ISBLANK(roomTypeFoyer__c) = FALSE, roomTypeFoyer__c < 0 ), AND( ISBLANK(roomTypeOutdoorPatio__c) = FALSE, roomTypeOutdoorPatio__c < 0 ), AND( ISBLANK(roomTypeSwimmingPool__c) = FALSE, roomTypeSwimmingPool__c < 0 ), AND( ISBLANK(roomTypeLaundryRoom__c) = FALSE, roomTypeLaundryRoom__c < 0 ), AND( ISBLANK(roomTypeOther__c) = FALSE, roomTypeOther__c < 0 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: At least one of the room types on Room Information is not a valid value (empty or positive number).
